resources.string: Light-Trail Duel
Glowing walls, one survivor. Steer left or right and trap your rivals.
Out-ride the computer. Computers fill the other zones.
2 to 4 people on one screen, each with their own pads. Computers can fill empty zones.
Best of 3 or best of 5. A drawn round is played again.
Arena size
A bigger arena gives more room to run and takes longer to fill.
Small
Large
Glowing orbs: Gap lets you slip through walls for a few cells, Boost doubles your speed for a moment.
Slower riders, a wider arena, and the game steers you away from a wall now and then. For players who find fast games hard.
Controls
How each player steers. One button is for players who cannot use two pads.
Two pads
A Left pad and a Right pad for each player.
One button
One button per player. It turns toward the side shown on it, and the side switches every moment.
Turn each player\'s controls to face their edge of the screen. Switch off to share the bottom edge.
Sumo Push
Round toy sumos in a shrinking ring. Shove everyone else out.
Push the computer out of the ring. Computers fill the other zones.
2 to 4 people on one screen, each with their own stick. Computers can fill empty zones.
A bigger ring takes more pushing to clear.
Orbs in the ring: Heavy makes you hard to shove, Sprint makes you quicker.
Slower sumos, a bigger ring that shrinks slowly, and a rope grip that stops you steering off the edge. For players who find fast games hard.
How each player steers. One button is for players who cannot use a stick.
Stick
Drag a thumb-stick to steer your sumo.
Direction pad
Hold a direction pad to steer your sumo.
Your sumo steers itself toward the nearest rival. You only press Dash.
